visualReplay.method: Read all 1440x900 WebGL RGBA pixels after two animation frames; seek later; return to same fractional mid-collapse time; compare FNV-1a framebuffer hashes

limits: The physical solve is coarse storey/column support and impact transfer. Architectural fragment flight is deterministic analytic motion, with ground contact, rather than independent fragment-to-fragment rigid-body collision.
The decorative chip pool is capped at 1400 and recycles under full-district destruction. Major source architectural primitives and slabs persist; individual decorative chips are not permanent.
Performance evidence is from this local browser and machine, not an independent fleet of modern laptops. Visual ambition remains a style assessment rather than a numerical guarantee.
